title: Model 1 — governance issue (input)
description: A single governance observation, stated neutrally, with the evidence and chronology that support it. One issue per object.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for the issue.

issue.description: The observation, stated neutrally. Describe what was found, not what it proves.

evidence.description: What was found AND by what method. Method matters: an absence established by audit sampling is not the same evidentiary object as an absence established by a records search.

chronology.description: The sequence, with periods identified. Use relative periods (Year 1, Q3) rather than real dates in published examples.

intended_use.description: What the assessment feeds into, e.g. assurance review, maturity assessment, audit finding.

authorising_instrument.description: Reference to any instrument that authorises the state observed — retention schedule, approved exemption, disposal certificate. Present and verified means the observation is accounted for, and the engine returns Tier 0. This field is what makes 'no issue' a derived outcome rather than a judgement call.

domain.description: Sector or context, for grouping only. Not scored.
